name: Aqara Smart Lock U200 (EU)

matter.note: Aqara states Matter over Thread. We did not open a CSA listing for the U200 itself (only a third-party tracker was seen).

apple_home.note: Needs an Apple home hub that is a Thread border router (HomePod mini, HomePod 2nd gen, Apple TV 4K).

google_home.note: Needs a Thread border router that supports Matter.

alexa.note: Needs a Thread border router that supports Matter.

smartthings.note: Needs a Thread border router that supports Matter.

home_assistant.note: Aqara's platform list includes Home Assistant; reached through Matter, which needs a Thread border router. Aqara's manual says third-party platforms get only basic functions.

hubRequired.note: Aqara's spec sheet says the lock is exclusively compatible with the Aqara M3 hub for best results, but also says any Matter-capable Thread border router is needed for Matter. Whether a hub is strictly required is unclear.

localControl.note: No Aqara source states local-only control.

lockFit.note: Specs mention Euro mortise locks with an emergency function. Installation type (retrofit or cylinder replacement) should be checked against the manual.

keypad.note: The kit has an outdoor keypad/fingerprint unit, powered by 4 AAA batteries or 12-24 V wiring. Check whether the EU kit includes it or sells it separately.

power.note: Lock: 7.4 V rechargeable Li-ion pack or 4 AA. Up to about 6 months per charge at 8 cycles a day.

summary: The Aqara Smart Lock U200 connects over Thread and Bluetooth and speaks Matter, so Aqara lists it for Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa, SmartThings and Home Assistant. Each platform needs a Thread border router that supports Matter, and Aqara points to its M3 hub as the best partner. The lock is powered by a rechargeable Li-ion pack or AA batteries, and the kit includes an outdoor keypad unit.
caveats: Matter needs a Thread border router; Aqara recommends its M3 hub.
Aqara's manual says third-party platforms currently get only basic lock and unlock functions.
Do not confuse it with the cheaper Smart Lock U200 Lite.
